claim_scope: lambda changes the fixed finite-horizon critic targets when bootstrap values are imperfect
a fixed imagined terminal-reward error propagates to every earlier full-return target
a continuation mask prevents a post-terminal reward from leaking into earlier targets
a valid truncated transition keeps value bootstrap while a natural terminal transition closes it
cumulative survival weights remove post-terminal steps from an imagined actor or critic objective

code.config: standard-library v3 analytic lambda-return, continuation, and loss-weighting fixture

data.name: hand-authored reward, discount, continuation, value, and per-step loss sequences

limitations: hand-authored scalar rewards and values rather than a learned world model or critic
no gradients, actor update, replay buffer, neural network, simulator, or environment interaction
the biased reward and collapsed-done cases are constructed counterexamples rather than measured model errors
cumulative weights use hand-authored discounts and non-negative scalar losses rather than a specific Dreamer implementation's indexing, normalization, reduction, gradients, or learned continuation
no Dreamer checkpoint, benchmark, GPU, robot, or vehicle
